DataCenterRoom.description: Lumped thermal model of a data center room: IT heat load, envelope losses, proportional cooling with COP-based electric power. Fast, self-contained (no MSL dependencies).
limitations: Conceptual, single-zone lumped model; it is not calibrated against a physical facility.
No spatial hot spots, humidity, airflow network, equipment transients, or sensor uncertainty.
Cooling uses a proportional controller and constant COP rather than a detailed plant model.
Successful execution is exploratory evidence and must not be described as publication-strength validation.

ChillerCooledIntegrated.description: LBNL Buildings 13.0.0 integrated primary-secondary waterside-economizer benchmark with stable RCP inputs and outputs.
limitations: Library regression validation does not constitute calibration against a physical facility.
The benchmark uses the DRYCOLD weather profile and a simplified computer-room load model.
Primary HVAC energy linearly bridges mover-power event samples outside the preregistered 0-2 MW physical screen; raw upstream energy is retained separately.
Results are valid only for the pinned Buildings and OpenModelica versions.
